# HaulAgua

> HaulAgua is a directory of bulk water hauling services across the United
> States. Visitors can search verified haulers by city and state for pool
> fills, construction and dust control, potable and drinking water,
> agricultural and livestock water, emergency response, oil and gas, and
> event water delivery. The directory currently covers Texas and Arizona
> with additional states in development.

Bulk water haulers serving Keller, TX. The following businesses
deliver bulk water in this area:

### Samantha Springs

- Phone: (817) 554-8800
- Website: https://www.samanthasprings.com/

Samantha Springs is Texas's leading provider of bulk spring water, sourced from our historic underground spring in Keller, TX. Originally rediscovered in 1984, the spring was fully developed and began delivering water in 1996. Whether you need bulk water for industrial use, pool filling, breweries, co-packers, or private-label bottling, we deliver 6,250 gallons per tanker directly to your site fast, fresh, and hassle-free.

### Grand Canyon Drinking Water

- Phone: (928) 679-3558
- Website: https://gcdwater.com/
- Services: Potable water

Our water storage facility is located in Red Lake, four miles north of Williams on Highway 64. Our water is hauled into our large water storage tanks from private wells in Bellemont in our 6,800-gallon tankers. From there it is loaded into either our 4,000-gallon or 2,000-gallon tankers for residential delivery. Our top priority is to provide the highest quality water.
